Title: God Going Before Israel Across the Jordan
Promise: Moses told Israel that God himself would cross ahead of them and clear away the nations on the other side, with Joshua crossing ahead of the people as their leader. Doubt: The words are Moses speaking about God rather than a direct divine speech in the text, and the substance duplicates the drafted conquest promises in Exodus 23 and Deuteronomy 20; it may be a restatement rather than a distinct promise.
